nodes.label: DETECT mode (RECV_MODE)
nodes.author: Hermes
nodes.rationale: Safe mode: receiver logs events but cannot write to Asana. Recommended to stay on until write code + guards exist.

nodes.label: AUTO mode (RECV_MODE=auto)
nodes.author: Hermes
nodes.rationale: AUTO mode does not exist yet: RECV_MODE only controls a log string/DB note; no Asana write code exists. Flipping it would write nothing while the business believed automation was live — deemed a more dangerous state than a visible failure.

nodes.label: INHOUSE flag
nodes.author: Hermes
nodes.rationale: The rule only ever SETS INHOUSE with no un-set path; a part later changed to buy-in still reads INHOUSE, causing name/field disagreement that downstream systems trust.

nodes.label: HMAC-SHA256 webhook signature verification
nodes.author: Hermes
nodes.rationale: The receiver never validates X-Hook-Signature, so anyone can POST forged events; HMAC verify over the raw body is the single gating control for the trust model.
